loansData.title: Personal Loan
loansData.bannerTitle: Support every milestone with a personal loan
loansData.bannerCardText: Access formal credit for your personal financial needs through a transparent, case-by-case assessment process.
loansData.aboutDescription: We help individuals meet their financial requirements through access to formal credit. The loan is evaluated based on the applicant’s profile, ensuring a fair assessment process. This offering is particularly suited for individuals who may face challenges accessing credit through traditional banking channels.

benefits.benefitText: Case-based evaluation of every application
Transparent and guided loan process
Focus on accessibility to formal credit
Separate application flow for personal loans
Loan terms are determined after assessment of applicant details and documents.
Applicable fees are communicated during the evaluation process.

loansData.eligibilitySectionText: Personal Loan eligibility is assessed on a case-to-case basis, based on the applicant’s profile, income stability, documentation, and internal evaluation criteria.
loansData.eligibilityConclusion: Final loan terms and approval are subject to internal assessment and verification.

process.title: Submit basic details
process.description: Fill in the application form and select Personal Loan as the loan type.

process.title: Review and assessment
process.description: Our team reviews the submitted information and documents for preliminary assessment.

process.title: Further communication
process.description: A loan officer will contact you within 48 working hours to guide you on the next steps. Loan approval is subject to verification and internal policies.

kycItems.point: Bank Passbook / Passport / Driving License / Utility Bill (Additional)
Bank statements for the last 1 year

loansData.conclusionText: Your loan's terms are determined on a case-to-case basis, considering several factors. To discuss your loan's details before applying, contact us today.
loansData.footerText: Share your basic details to begin the process. Our team will review your request and connect with you for further guidance.

faq.question: Who can apply for a Personal Loan?
faq.answer: Salaried individuals, self-employed individuals, and professionals can apply. All applications are assessed on a case-to-case basis.

faq.question: How is eligibility determined?
faq.answer: Eligibility depends on factors such as applicant profile, income stability, documentation, and internal assessment criteria.

faq.question: Is there a fixed interest rate for personal loans?
faq.answer: Interest rates are determined after assessment and may vary based on the applicant’s profile and internal policies.

faq.question: How long does the approval process take?
faq.answer: After submitting basic details, a loan officer contacts the applicant within 48 working hours. Final timelines depend on verification and documentation.

faq.question: What documents are required to apply?
faq.answer: Basic KYC and financial documents are required. Additional documents may be requested based on the assessment.

faq.question: Does meeting eligibility criteria guarantee loan approval?
faq.answer: No, meeting basic eligibility criteria does not guarantee loan approval. All applications are subject to verification and internal policies.

faq.question: How will I know my loan terms?
faq.answer: Loan amount, interest rate, tenure, and applicable fees are communicated after assessment of the applicant’s details and documents.

faq.question: Is this loan suitable for working capital needs?
faq.answer: Yes, business loans may be structured to support working capital or operational requirements, subject to assessment.

faq.question: Are both secured and unsecured business loans available?
faq.answer: Yes, the availability of secured or unsecured facilities depends on the business profile and assessment.

faq.question: Are interest rates fixed?
faq.answer: Interest rates are determined after evaluation and may vary based on business risk and loan structure.

faq.question: How long does the process take?
faq.answer: A loan officer contacts the applicant within 48 working hours after submission. Timelines depend on documentation and verification.

faq.question: Does submitting an application guarantee approval?
faq.answer: No, all applications are subject to internal assessment and verification.

faq.question: What documents are required to apply for a business loan?
faq.answer: Basic identity, business, and financial documents are required. The exact list depends on the business profile and loan structure and will be communicated during verification.

faq.question: Can I speak to someone before applying?
faq.answer: Yes, you can request a call back and our team will connect with you to understand your requirements and guide you through the process.
